  - heading "Distance Formula ☆" [level=1]
  - paragraph: "Objective: Derive and use the distance between two coordinate points."
  - text: ◷ 18 min Class 10 Coordinate Geometry
  - navigation:
    - button "INTERACT"
    - button "LEARN"
    - button "EXAMPLE"
    - button "FORMULA"
    - button "PRACTICE"
  - main:
    - complementary:
      - heading "Explore on the coordinate plane" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Drag points A or B, or edit their coordinates. See the right triangle, differences, and distance update live.
      - heading "● Point A (x1, y1)" [level=3]
      - text: x
      - subscript: "1"
      - spinbutton "Point A x": "1"
      - text: "y"
      - subscript: "1"
      - spinbutton "Point A y": "2"
      - heading "● Point B (x2, y2)" [level=3]
      - text: x
      - subscript: "2"
      - spinbutton "Point B x": "5"
      - text: "y"
      - subscript: "2"
      - spinbutton "Point B y": "5"
      - heading "Differences" [level=3]
      - paragraph: Horizontal |x₂ − x₁| = 4
      - paragraph: Vertical |y₂ − y₁| = 3
      - heading "Distance" [level=3]
      - paragraph: d = √[(x₂−x₁)² + (y₂−y₁)²]
      - paragraph: = √(4² + 3²) = √25
      - strong: d = 5.00 units
      - checkbox "Show grid" [checked]
      - text: "Show grid Grid:"
      - combobox "Grid size":
        - option "0.5 unit"
        - option "1 unit" [selected]
        - option "2 units"
    - article:
      - button "Reset view":
        - img
        - text: Reset view
      - img "Draggable distance formula coordinate plane": A (1, 2) B (5, 5) 4 units 3 units 5 units
      - text: ━ Horizontal difference (|x₂−x₁|) ━ Vertical difference (|y₂−y₁|) ━ Distance (d)
      - button "Toggle fullscreen graph":
        - img
    - article:
      - heading "Why this works" [level=2]
      - paragraph: The horizontal and vertical differences form the legs of a right triangle. By the Pythagorean Theorem, the distance between A and B is the hypotenuse.
      - text: d² = |x₂−x₁|² + |y₂−y₁|²
    - article:
      - heading "Worked example" [level=2]
      - paragraph: Find the distance between A(1, 2) and B(5, 5).
      - paragraph: x₂ − x₁ = 5 − 1 = 4
      - paragraph: y₂ − y₁ = 5 − 2 = 3
      - paragraph: d = √(4² + 3²) = √25
      - strong: Distance = 5.00 units
